Scalar operations

Use ordinary Julia operators and functions with DoubleFloats. The following groups cover common operations. See Special Functions for functions such as erf and Linear Algebra for operations on whole matrices.

TaskRepresentative functions
Arithmetic+, -, *, /, ^, fma, muladd, inv, square, cube, sqrt, cbrt
Rounding and integer partsround, floor, ceil, trunc, spread, intpart, fracpart
Exponentials and logarithmsexp, exp2, exp10, expm1, log, log2, log10, log1p
Circular functionssin, cos, tan, sincos, cis, sinpi, cospi, tanpi, asin, acos, atan
Hyperbolic functionssinh, cosh, tanh, asinh, acosh, atanh
Magnitudesabs, abs2, hypot
Predicatesiszero, isone, isinteger, isfinite, isinf, isnan, issubnormal

The package also exports predicates such as isnonzero, ispositive, isnegative, isnonnegative, isnonpositive, isposinf, isneginf, and isfractional. To compare computed answers, see Choosing and checking precision.

Widen an arithmetic operation

For two inputs of the same underlying float type, add2, sub2, mul2, and div2 perform arithmetic and return the corresponding DoubleFloat type. The infix equivalents are ⊕, ⊖, ⊗, and ⊘. For example, add2(1.0, 2.0^-60) retains the small addend in the low component. See Representation and precision.
